content_sections.heading: BECIL Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: BECIL Recruitment 2026 carries 41 tentative contractual vacancies across 10 posts for the Central Government Hospital, Delhi NCR. The notification notes the number of posts may increase or decrease as per the Client/Principal Employer's requirement.

content_sections.heading: BECIL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Educational qualification requirements differ by post, as detailed below.

rows.essential_qualification: B.Sc. in Speech and Hearing from a recognized institution/university, registered with the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI); M.Sc. in Speech and Hearing and clinical hospital experience is desirable.

EMT-Basic/EMT-Advanced Certification from institutes approved by the Health Sector Skill Council (National Skill Development Programme, Govt. of India), OR Pre-Hospital Trauma Technician certification from institutes approved by the Directorate General of Health Services, Govt. of India. Role includes patient transfer/care in ambulances and manning the Ambulance Control Room in shifts.

Bachelor's Degree in Life Sciences with a full-time Post Graduate qualification in Hospital/Healthcare Management from a recognized University, plus at least 1 year of hospital experience after Post-Graduation. Role includes managing Patient Care Coordinators and patient flow to OPDs.
12th pass (Science) plus 2 years' post-qualification experience as a Lab Attendant.
12th pass (Science) with a minimum 2-year diploma from a DCI-recognized institution, plus a minimum 2 years' post-qualification experience as dental mechanic/dental technician.

10th pass/Matriculate from any recognized board, plus at least 1 year of work experience as bearer-cum-waiter/utility worker in a catering establishment, food outlet, or culinary service (hospital/hotel etc.), and a certificate in food handler hygiene/safety training from a certified Govt./NSDC-recognized agency.
B.Sc. (Anesthesia & Operation Theatre Technologist), OR B.Sc. (OT Technology)/B.Sc. (Anesthesia Technology) from a recognized University/Institute.

Diploma in Pharmacy from a recognized institution/board, registered as a Pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act, 1948. A Degree in Pharmacy and dispensing/storage experience in a hospital, drug store, or pharmaceutical concern is desirable.
B.Sc. (Hons.) in Radiography, or B.Sc. in Radiography (3-year course) from a recognized university/institution.

content_sections.heading: BECIL Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: BECIL Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is payable online at the time of registration and is non-refundable and non-transferable. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application, and pay the fee separately, for each post.

content_sections.heading: BECIL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are scrutinized and shortlisted based on the eligibility criteria prescribed for each post; meeting the eligibility criteria does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called for further stages. Preference may be given to candidates with higher qualifications, superior academic credentials, additional relevant experience, or other criteria decided by the Client/Principal Employer. The shortlisted list is forwarded to the Client/Principal Employer for further selection - interview, assessment, skill test, or other evaluation method as decided by the Client. Shortlisted candidates are informed of the date, time, and venue/mode of interview/assessment/skill test via registered email and/or telephone. Only the final result - the list of candidates selected by the Client/Principal Employer - is published on the BECIL website; interim results or stage-wise marks are not published. Preference may be given to local candidates and/or those with relevant experience in the same or similar department, subject to Client requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BECIL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official registration portal at becilregistration.in. Complete New Registration by filling in your personal details. Proceed to fill other application details. Pay the applicable application processing fee online to complete submission. Save the application receipt after successful payment. If applying for more than one post, submit a separate application (with separate fee payment) for each post. Ensure the completed application, with all requisite documents, reaches BECIL on or before 21 September 2026, 18:00 Hrs.

content_sections.heading: BECIL Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the prescribed date and time (21.09.2026, 18:00 Hrs) shall not be considered and will be summarily rejected. No modification, correction, or alteration of submitted application details will be entertained after submission. No TA/DA is admissible for attending any test, document verification, interview, or for joining duty upon selection. Candidature remains provisional at all stages and is subject to verification of original documents relating to age, qualification, experience, and category. Candidates previously engaged by BECIL and/or the Client whose services were terminated/discontinued/not renewed due to disciplinary action, misconduct, or unsatisfactory performance are not eligible to apply. Candidates must not directly approach the Client/Principal Employer regarding this recruitment; canvassing in any form leads to disqualification. BECIL reserves the right to cancel, modify, restrict, enlarge, curtail, postpone, or reopen the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason, and to not fill any or all advertised vacancies. BECIL does not authorize any agent, intermediary, consultant, or third party for recruitment; candidates should beware of fraudulent job offers and refer only to www.becil.com for authentic updates. Any dispute arising from this recruitment is subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of competent courts at New Delhi.

faq.question: Q1. What is BECIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Vacancy Advertisement No. 556 by Broadcast Engineering Consultants India Limited (BECIL), inviting applications for 41 contractual paramedical/technical posts for deployment in a Central Government Hospital, Delhi NCR.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in BECIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 41 tentative vacancies across 10 posts, including Patient Care Manager, Lab Attendant, Food Bearer, OT Technologist, Jr. Physiotherapist, Pharmacist, and Radiographer (5 each), and Technical Assistant ENT, EMT Technician, and Dental Technician (2 each).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BECIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 21 September 2026, up to 18:00 Hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for BECIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post, ranging from 10th pass (Food Bearer) to Bachelor's/Diploma-level clinical qualifications (Radiographer, OT Technologist, Pharmacist, etc.) — see the post-wise qualification table above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BECIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Age limit varies by post, from 18–40 years (Food Bearer) to 21–35 years (Lab Attendant, Radiographer) to "no bar" (Dental Technician); several posts do not specify an age limit in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for BECIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 295 for all categories except SC/ST and PwD candidates, who are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for BECIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By registering and submitting the application at becilregistration.in, with the applicable fee paid online, before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for BECIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on eligibility, followed by interview/assessment/skill test as decided by the Client/Principal Employer; only the final selected list is published.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for BECIL contractual hospital posts?
faq.answer: Consolidated monthly pay ranges from Rs. 21,502 (Food Bearer) to Rs. 40,710 (Technical Assistant ENT, Jr. Physiotherapist, Radiographer), varying by post.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No. This is purely a contractual engagement through BECIL for deployment at a Central Government Hospital; it is not a regular/permanent government appointment.
